# Grouped Configuration Reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate-config-docs.py; review schema changes before regenerating. -->

Generated from the current compiled CLI `schema` output, including actual fields, constraints and defaults.
Both languages use the same schema. Object-schema required fields do not replace final composed-configuration validation;
a base document may supply an omitted value. A null language standard freezes to C17 or C++23 according to the source language.
Target, toolchain and extension capabilities still require actual evidence.

## Usage and evidence

Configuration fragments accept only fields defined by the current schema. Plugin option schemas are registered in their owning namespace during bootstrap.
Unknown fields cannot bypass validation through a global ignore switch; old flat configuration is not read.
Input, ABI, semantics, cache and publication requirements are described in the guide. Schema coverage is not invocation or distribution certification.
